reviews.title: Supreme fabric thickness and earth shade
reviews.comment: The 240 GSM organic cotton feels incredibly substantial yet breathable in South Indian weather. The deep forest green is uniquely rich and subtle—nothing like generic olive green.

reviews.title: Best oversized silhouette I own
reviews.comment: The drape around the shoulders and neck ribbing is flawless. Has survived 4 wash cycles and zero shrinkage.

reviews.title: The linen-cotton blend is exquisite
reviews.comment: Natural coconut buttons and the sage tone are sensational. Received compliments the first time I wore it out.

reviews.title: Mountain-grade comfort
